state.case_summary:
A woman in her 50s presented with bilateral nasal obstruction, thick nasal discharge, and facial pain and pressure. Her condition was recalcitrant to 3 prior surgeries, immunotherapy, and medical therapy.

Initial post-procedure examination showed:- Binocular horizontal diplopia with left lateral gaze- Inability for the left eye to track beyond the midline- Left eye was not proptotic, ecchymotic, or tense- Bedside intraocular pressure measurements: 15 OD, 16 OS (normal)- National Institutes of Health stroke score of 1
